headline: Alphabet Shares Fall as Q3 Net Profit Drops 25% on High Spending
summary: Alphabet shares fell over 10% after third-quarter net profit dropped 25% year-over-year to $26.2 billion. Despite revenue rising to $127.6 billion, profit missed estimates due to slower ad growth and high AI infrastructure expenses.
why: Alphabet is the parent company of Google and a major benchmark for online advertising demand and artificial intelligence capital expenditure.

impacts.name: Alphabet
impacts.why: Profit missing expectations amid high capital expenditure reduces near-term earnings outlook.

why_moved: An advertising slowdown combined with escalating capital expenditure spooked tech investors.
